verdict.rationale: The evidence includes material taken from npm's public GitHub repository (github.com/npm/cli) and the npm/registry repo, which implies the CLI source is publicly readable. Nothing in the pack states what license it is under, so the 'open license' half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: explicit statement of an open-source license (e.g., LICENSE file or license name), first-party docs pointing to source availability, independent corroboration of openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
